_meta.description: Authoritative Lean-parity parameters for the CAMPAIGN_002 H4 trend_following baseline, extracted from the committed campaign config — not hand-copied.
_meta.note: Verification infrastructure only. CAMPAIGN_002 is already REJECT; a parity run validates the engine, it cannot approve any strategy.

cost_model.fill_rule: bid/ask-aware: a long enters at the ask, a short at the bid, plus the slippage above
cost_model.note: CAMPAIGN_002 ran before the fill-timing model existed, so its behaviour corresponds to fill_timing=signal_bar_close. A next_bar_open parity would be a separate, later comparison.

sizing.rule: fixed fractional — risk_per_trade_pct of equity per trade

first_parity_target.note: Start with EUR_USD over the full window; expand to the other pairs only if single-pair parity passes.

excluded_from_parity: RiskEngine spread / session / correlation / margin filters — bespoke; compare only the bespoke engine's accepted trades
